title: Reprogramming mouse embryonic fibroblasts using different  reprogramming factors
protocol: Plate 8x10^6 Plat-E cells per 10-cm dish uniformly.
Culture the plated Plat-E cells in 10% FBS medium for 16 hours until they reach 70-80% confluence.
Replace the medium of confluent Plat-E cells with 7.5 ml fresh 10% FBS medium.
For each factor, add 1068 μl ddH2O, 25 μg plasmid DNA, and 156.25 μl 2M CaCl2 to a 15-ml tube in sequence.
Mix the solution vigorously after adding 2X HBS, then incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the mixture into the dish with fresh medium.
Replace the medium of transfected Plat-E cells with 10 ml fresh medium 11-14 hours post-transfection.
Collect the supernatant containing virus by syringe and filter through a 0.45 μm filter as the first virus stock, 48 hours after transfection.
Add 10 ml fresh Pla-E medium to transfected Plat-E cells and harvest 24 hours later as the second virus stock.
Thaw frozen Passage 1 OG2 MEFs in a 6-cm dish with MEF Medium.
Culture the thawed OG2 MEFs in the CO2 incubator until they reach full confluence.
Split confluent MEFs to P12 or P24 plates at different cell densities.
Infect MEFs with the virus stock.

Mix the virus stock with an equal volume and add one volume of fresh MEF medium for OKSM induced reprogramming: 0.5ml Oct4, 0.5ml Klf4, 0.5ml Sox2, 0.5ml Myc, and 0.5ml fresh MEF medium (Total 2.5ml) for one well of a 12-well plate.

Mix the virus stock with an equal volume and add one volume of fresh MEF medium for OKS induced reprogramming: 0.5ml Oct4, 0.5ml Klf4, 0.5ml Sox2, and 0.5ml fresh MEF medium (Total 2ml) for one well of a 12-well plate.

Mix the virus stock with an equal volume and add one volume of fresh MEF medium for OKS induced reprogramming: 0.25ml Oct4, 0.25ml Klf4, 0.25ml Sox2, and 0.25ml fresh MEF medium (Total 2ml) for one well of a 24-well plate.

Mix the virus stock with an equal volume and add one volume of fresh MEF medium for Oct4/Jhdm1b/Id1 induced reprogramming: 0.5ml Oct4, 0.5ml Jhdm1b, 0.5ml Id1, and 0.5ml fresh MEF medium (Total 2ml) for one well of a 12-well plate.
Plate 6x10^6 HEK93T cells per 10-cm dish uniformly.
Culture the cells in 10% FBS medium for 16 hours to reach 70-80% confluence.
Replace the medium of HEK93T cells in a 10-cm dish with 7.5 ml of fresh 10% FBS medium.
Add 1070 μl ddH2O, 12.5 μg pW-TRE-c-Jun/pW-rtTA, 7.5 μg psPAX2, and 5 μg psMD2.G to a 15 ml tube successively.
Add 156.25 μl of 2M CaCl2 to the tube.
Add 1.25 ml of 2XHBS to the tube and mix vigorously.
Incubate the mixture for 2 min at room temperature.
Transfer the 2.5 ml mixture into the dish containing fresh medium.
Replace the medium of transfected HEK93T cells in a 10 cm dish with 10 ml of fresh medium 11-14 hours after transfection.
Incubate the cells continuously.
Collect the supernatant from the transfected HEK93T cells using a syringe and filter it through a 0.45 μm filter to obtain the first virus stock, 48 hours post-transfection.
Add 10 ml of fresh HEK93T medium to the transfected cells.
Harvest the supernatant 24 hours after adding fresh medium to obtain the second virus stock.

Infect MEFs with a mixture containing 0.5 ml each of Oct4, Sox2, and Klf4 pMXs-based retroviruses, 0.125 ml each of c-Jun pW-TRE-based lentivirus and rtTA pW-based lentivirus, and 0.5 ml fresh MEF medium.
Infect the MEFs with virus stock carrying Oct4, Klf4, Sox2, and c-Jun coding sequences.
Add polybrene to a final concentration of 4 μg/ml.
Repeat the infection with the second virus stock 24 hours after the first infection.
Replace the virus-containing medium with fresh reprogramming medium at post-infection Day0.
Change the medium daily and observe the morphology changes.
Count GFP+ colonies at appropriate days.
